title: Nature's Renewal/Skill history

{{Skill history}}

== February 9, 2026 ==
* Decreased cast time to 3s
* Increased duration to 30-240s
* Increased range to 3500

== August 25, 2005 ==
* The effects of [[Spirit]]s no longer work on other Spirits.
: ''Example: '''Fertile Season''' no longer adds [[Health]] and [[Armor rating|armor]] to other Spirits.''
* When a Spirit is cast, it kills all other [[Ally|allied]] Spirits of the same type within its [[Spirit range|range]].
* Modified to no longer remove all [[Hex]]es and [[Enchantment spell|Enchantments]] when cast.
* Now doubles the [[Energy degeneration]] for [[Upkeep|maintained]] Enchantments.

== Pre-release ==
During early development, Enchantments and Hexes could not be cast at all for the duration of this skill, as mentioned by an alpha tester in the Photics e-zine Issue #5<ref>https://photics.com/issues/issue05.pdf</ref>.
